# V1.13.2

Section: Source

**V1.13.2** of *[Stormworks: Build and Rescue](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Stormworks:_Build_and_Rescue)* was released on December 16 16th, 2024.

## V1.13.2

- Feature - [#25481](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/25481) Sawmill and farm locations on Meier and Sawyer isles
- Feature - [#25481](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/25481) Trailer cargo missions
- Rework - [#2548](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/2548) Doubled Microcontroller lua script limit
- Fix - [#25838](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/25838) 3x3 Wheel no longer requires research in classic mode
- Fix - [#25893](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/25893) Increase reliability of hospital ship zone checking
